description: Form transitions of an existing Long Binary value by Edit/Update: row 3 grows from 50 to 5000 bytes; row 4 shrinks from 5000 to 50; row 3 grows again to 9000; row 5 shrinks from 9000 to 5000. Asks how the old long-value space and the row's reference change in each direction. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
